source: Claude, d'après l'arbre du dépôt et le README
explication_en: Workflows are described with the WIO type built via the builders, then an interpreter runs them in a runtime of your choice (Pekko, database, memory). A web API and an interface expose the instances, and MermaidRenderer draws the diagrams.
